evals.name: Extract LinkedIn Ads - Payoneer
evals.description: Test extraction of LinkedIn ads from Payoneer search results with complete country and targeting data
evals.prompt: Extract LinkedIn ads from this URL: https://www.linkedin.com/ad-library/search?accountOwner=payoneer&payer=Payoneer

assertions.description: At least one ad must be extracted
Each ad must have an ad_id
Each ad must have about section
Total impressions range must be extracted
Must extract more than 4 countries (proves 'Show more' was clicked)
Each country entry must have country name
Each country entry must have percentage
by_date field should NOT exist (removed from schema)

expectations: The output is a valid JSON file
The JSON contains a search_metadata section with total_ads_found
The JSON contains an ads array with at least one ad
Each ad has structured data including 'about', 'impressions', and 'targeting' sections
The skill used Playwright MCP tools (browser_navigate, browser_snapshot, etc.)
The skill scrolled the page 3 times to load more ads
The ad detail pages were visited and data was extracted
The 'Show more' button was clicked in Impressions section to reveal all countries
The impressions.by_country array contains more than 4 countries
No 'by_date' field exists in impressions (country-based only)
The 'x others' buttons were clicked in targeting section if present
Languages and locations are arrays (not strings)

evals.name: Extract LinkedIn Ads - Microsoft
evals.description: Test extraction with detailed targeting information from Microsoft ads
evals.prompt: I need to analyze competitor ads. Go to https://www.linkedin.com/ad-library/search?accountOwner=microsoft&payer=Microsoft and extract all the ad data you can find. I'm particularly interested in the targeting criteria they use.

assertions.description: Must have more than 4 countries (Show more was clicked)

expectations: The output is a valid JSON file with Microsoft ads data
The targeting section is populated with available data (locations, languages, details)
Multiple ads were extracted (not just one)
The skill navigated to individual ad detail pages
The JSON structure follows the expected schema with about/impressions/targeting sections
The 'Show more' button was clicked for impressions
Country data is in by_country array (not by_date)

evals.name: Extract LinkedIn Ads - Google with Creatives
evals.description: Test extraction of creative URLs and landing pages
evals.prompt: Extract LinkedIn advertising data from https://www.linkedin.com/ad-library/search?accountOwner=google&payer=Google. Make sure to get the ad creative URLs and landing pages.

assertions.description: Creative URLs must be an array

expectations: The output is a valid JSON file
Creative URLs are extracted and included in the 'about' section
Landing page URLs are captured
The skill properly handled the infinite scroll
Data is structured according to the expected format
The 'Show more' button was clicked for complete country data
Country data uses by_country array (not by_date)

impressions.description: Impressions must use country-based structure (by_country array), NOT date-based (by_date). The 'Show more' button must be clicked to extract all 60+ countries, not just the initial 4.

targeting.description: Languages and locations must be arrays. The 'x others' buttons must be clicked to reveal complete lists.

about.description: Advertiser and format are required. The '…see more' button must be clicked to expand truncated ad text. Creative URLs must be an array.

test_scenarios.description: If 'Show more' button is not present in Impressions section, extract visible countries only
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: Extract 4 visible countries and log warning, don't fail extraction

test_scenarios.description: If 'x others' button is not present in targeting, extract visible items only
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: Extract visible languages/locations as arrays and continue

test_scenarios.description: If '…see more' button is not present, extract visible text only
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: Extract visible ad text and continue

test_scenarios.description: If one ad fails to extract, continue with remaining ads
test_scenarios.expected_behavior: Log error for failed ad, continue extraction, save successful ads

common_mistakes_to_avoid.detection: by_country array has 4 or fewer entries

common_mistakes_to_avoid.impact: Incorrect schema - LinkedIn uses country-based impressions

common_mistakes_to_avoid.mistake: Not clicking '…see more' for ad text
common_mistakes_to_avoid.detection: Ad text ends with '…' or is very short
languages or locations is not an array type
Only 1-2 items in languages/locations when 'x others' was present
